questions.scenario: You are craving a midnight packet of Maggi but also want to be healthy. What do you do?

options.text: Quickly boil some eggs or soya chunks to mix in, making it a high-protein post-workout meal.
Turn the packet around to check the exact sodium content, saturated fats, and the refined flour (maida) percentage.
Chop colorful veggies and use healthy wheat noodles to make it look like an aesthetic, masterchef-level dish.
Think about how a 'Healthy High-Protein Maggi' startup could easily make millions among hostel students.

questions.scenario: Mummy makes extra ghee aloo parathas for Sunday breakfast. How do you approach this?

options.text: Eat them happily but plan to do an extra 30 minutes of cardio or play football in the evening to burn it off.
Mentally calculate the exact calories and the fat-to-carb ratio of the ghee and potatoes before taking a bite.
Suggest making a healthier version using paneer stuffing, less oil, and presenting it beautifully with fresh mint chutney.
Convince your family to start a Sunday cloud kitchen delivering these exact tasty parathas but with a 'diet-friendly' marketing tag.

questions.scenario: Your friends drag you out for street food like Momos and Chhole Bhature. What's your move?

options.text: Skip the oily Bhature, just eat the Chhole for the chickpea protein, and challenge your friends to an arm-wrestling match.
Worry about the reuse of the street vendor's palm oil and how the unhygienic chutney might mess up your gut microbiome.
Enjoy it, but immediately go home and try to bake healthy, steamed wheat momos with a vibrant spinach wrapper.
Notice how incredibly crowded the stall is and calculate the daily profit margin of the momo-wale bhaiya.

questions.scenario: It's board exam season and you need energy to study late into the night. What is your strategy?

options.text: Do 20 quick jumping jacks and eat a peanut butter sandwich for an instant physical energy boost.
Research which specific vitamins (like Omega-3 or B12) actually improve brain focus and memory retention.
Prepare a fancy, aesthetic trail mix bowl with roasted makhana, almonds, and dark chocolate to munch on.
Plan out a perfect 'Student Energy Diet Chart' and charge your friends ₹100 to share the PDF.

questions.scenario: A big family wedding (Shaadi) is coming up in two months. How are you preparing?

options.text: Starting a strict home-workout and protein diet plan to get lean and look sharp in your ethnic wear.
Getting a blood test to check why your skin is breaking out and fixing your vitamin intake based on the reports.
Experimenting with glowing-skin detox waters, chia seeds, and beautiful fruit salads to get that natural glow.
Organizing a paid 30-day 'Wedding Weight-Loss Challenge' for all your cousins and managing everyone's meals.

questions.scenario: You get a bad viral fever and Mummy forces you to drink Haldi Doodh (Turmeric Milk) and Kadha. What is your reaction?

options.text: Gulp it down quickly, hoping it helps your body recover fast so you can get back to playing sports outside.
Google the active compound 'curcumin' in turmeric to see if there is actual scientific proof that it reduces inflammation.
Add a little honey and cinnamon, froth the milk perfectly, and turn it into a fancy, aesthetic 'Golden Latte'.
Think about launching a ready-to-drink, tasty Ayurvedic Kadha brand in cool packaging that teenagers won't hate.

questions.scenario: You are opening your school tiffin/lunchbox during recess. What goes through your mind?

options.text: Complaining that there isn't enough protein to build muscle and trading your roti for your friend's egg bhurji.
Explaining to your friend why their daily white-bread jam sandwich is just an insulin spike waiting to happen.
Feeling proud because you packed a colourful, Pinterest-style healthy salad or a beautifully rolled paneer wrap.
Realizing nobody likes eating healthy tiffins and planning to sell a daily tasty-yet-healthy lunchbox service in school.

questions.scenario: You are at a local supermarket (like Reliance Smart or D-Mart) with your parents. Where do you go?

options.text: Head straight to the sports aisle to check out the new peanut butters, oats, and whey protein brands.
Read the tiny ingredient list on the back of 'Diet' snacks to catch hidden sugars like maltodextrin or artificial sweeteners.
Pick up exotic fruits, avocados, or colorful bell peppers to make a gorgeous, healthy dinner for the family.
Look at how health foods are priced 3x higher and brainstorm how to market your own affordable health snack.

questions.scenario: You join a local gym or start playing a new sport. What becomes your obsession?

options.text: Figuring out the exact pre-workout meal to give you maximum energy and tracking your lifting progress.
Reading detailed articles about muscle protein synthesis and how different amino acids affect recovery times.
Making amazing post-workout smoothie bowls topped with granola that look too good to eat.
Wondering how much the gym owner actually makes by selling imported whey protein boxes at the front desk.

questions.scenario: You are scrolling through YouTube or Instagram Reels. Which video makes you stop and watch?

options.text: 'What I eat in a day to stay shredded' or Virat Kohli's intense fitness and diet routine.
Doctors explaining how reverse diabetes works or the actual biology behind intermittent fasting.
Aesthetic, fast-paced ASMR videos of someone baking a beautiful, guilt-free, zero-sugar chocolate cake.
'How this 22-year-old built a 100-Crore healthy snack brand starting from their home kitchen.'

Sports_Nutritionist.title: The Fitness Fueler (Sports Nutritionist)
Sports_Nutritionist.primary_match_text: You are all about action, energy, and physical performance! You understand that food is the ultimate fuel for the human machine.
Sports_Nutritionist.day_in_the_life: Working with athletes, gym-goers, and sports teams, designing high-protein meal plans, and helping clients build muscle, increase stamina, or lose fat.
Sports_Nutritionist.alternative_match_text: Your love for fitness and the human body would also make you a fantastic Fitness Trainer, Physiotherapist, or Sports Coach.
Sports_Nutritionist.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th Science (PCB) or Home Science -> B.Sc in Nutrition & Dietetics -> Specialized Diploma in Sports Nutrition -> Certification from renowned boards like ISSA or ACE.

Clinical_Dietitian.title: The Macro Scientist (Clinical Dietitian / Food Scientist)
Clinical_Dietitian.primary_match_text: You have a sharp, analytical mind! You see food as medicine and rely on hard data, blood reports, and science to fix health issues.
Clinical_Dietitian.day_in_the_life: Working in big hospitals, reading patient blood reports, calculating precise macros, planning exact diets for diabetic or heart patients, and curing diseases through food.
Clinical_Dietitian.alternative_match_text: Your analytical brain and love for biology make you a great fit for roles like Pathologist, Food Technologist, or Public Health Researcher.
Clinical_Dietitian.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th Science (PCB). Entrance: CUET/State exams -> B.Sc in Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics -> M.Sc in Clinical Nutrition + 6-month hospital internship to become a Registered Dietitian (RD).

Culinary_Dietitian.title: The Healthy Masterchef (Culinary Dietitian / Recipe Creator)
Culinary_Dietitian.primary_match_text: You are a creative foodie! You believe that healthy food doesn't have to be boring, and you love making nutritious meals look and taste incredible.
Culinary_Dietitian.day_in_the_life: Inventing healthy versions of popular junk food, doing aesthetic food photography, writing recipe blogs, and consulting for healthy modern cafes.
Culinary_Dietitian.alternative_match_text: Your artistic eye and love for food would also make you an incredible Chef, Food Stylist, or Food Vlogger.
Culinary_Dietitian.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th Any Stream (Home Science preferred) -> Degree: B.Sc/BA in Culinary Arts or B.Sc in Nutrition & Dietetics -> Build a strong social media portfolio of healthy recipes.

Supplement_Brand_Owner.title: The Wellness Boss (Health Supplement Brand Owner)
Supplement_Brand_Owner.primary_match_text: You have a sharp business brain! You see the big picture in the fitness industry and want to build an empire, not just write diet charts.
Supplement_Brand_Owner.day_in_the_life: Launch a new range of protein bars, managing your own chain of diet clinics, negotiating with suppliers, and marketing your health products to the masses.
Supplement_Brand_Owner.alternative_match_text: Your leadership and strategic thinking make you perfect for roles like Entrepreneur, Marketing Manager, or Product Manager.
Supplement_Brand_Owner.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th Commerce or Science -> Degree: BBA, B.Com, or B.Sc in Food Technology -> MBA in Entrepreneurship or Healthcare Management -> Gain experience in FMCG startups.
